00-database-setup.ts.description: Data analyst (project 7): one-off setup. Creates the Ironleaf Fitness demo database (schema ironleaf), the read-only reader role and the safe query function.

01-answer-question.ts.description: Data analyst (project 7): one plain-English question to one answer. GPT-5.4 writes SQL, code checks it, Postgres runs it read-only, one auto-fix on error, GPT-5.4 mini explains the rows.

02-chat-api.ts.description: Data analyst (project 7): the analyst chat page and its API. Keeps the last questions per chat for follow-ups and logs every question.

03-weekly-anomalies.ts.description: Data analyst (project 7): Monday report. Fixed SQL compares last week with the 8 weeks before for each branch; code flags unusual numbers; GPT-5.4 writes the summary.

04-evaluation.ts.description: Data analyst (project 7): runs 19 test questions, compares the assistant's numbers with reference SQL and saves the scores.

05-send-email.ts.description: Data analyst (project 7): sends an email with Gmail in live mode or writes it to the Ironleaf Outbox table in test mode.
